data.context: In the 2014 Report on patent backlogs, inventories and pendency, section 3, this passage describes IP Australia’s patent application inventory from 2000 to 2012. It compares the proportions in stocks 1, 2 and 3, noting stock 1’s dominance, stock 2’s share in relation to examiner stock-out concerns, and a peak that coincided with fewer examiners.
